headline: Your heart beats 100,000 times a day without you thinking about it once
universal_truth: The most essential work often happens without conscious effort
fun_facts: Your heart beats about 100,000 times per day—that's 35 million times a year
The heart generates its own electrical impulse—it can beat even outside the body
In a lifetime, the average heart pumps enough blood to fill three supertankers
discussion_questions: What essential work happens in your life without you thinking about it?
How does knowing your heart beats 100,000 times daily change your appreciation for it?
What would change if you had to consciously control your heartbeat?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Right now, without any effort from you, your heart is beating. It's been beating since before you were born. It will beat 35 million times this year. You never have to remember—your heart never forgets. It's the most reliable thing in your life.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: Most muscles need signals from your brain to move. But your heart beats continuously without conscious control. It even beats if removed from the body. How does the heart keep its own rhythm?
cliff.prompt: How does the heart beat without brain control?

options.text: The heart has its own pacemaker cells that generate electrical impulses
options.response: Yes. The sinoatrial node generates its own rhythm. Your heart is self-powered.

options.text: The autonomic nervous system controls heartbeat below conscious awareness
options.response: The nervous system modulates heart rate, but the heart generates its own beat...

q1.title: 100,000 Beats
q1.script: Your heart beats about 100,000 times every day. That's 35 million times per year, 2.5 billion times in a lifetime. Each beat pumps blood through 60,000 miles of vessels. The heart never takes a break.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "100,000 Beats"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Self-Starting
q2.script: The sinoatrial node—your heart's natural pacemaker—generates electrical impulses that trigger each heartbeat. This is why a heart can beat in a dish or be transplanted. It carries its own rhythm.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Supertanker Volumes
q3.script: Over a lifetime, your heart pumps about 1 million barrels of blood—enough to fill three supertankers. Each minute, your entire blood volume circulates once. The heart is the most hardworking muscle in your body.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: The most essential work often happens without conscious effort. Your heart reminds us that reliability doesn't require attention, and that the most dependable things often go unnoticed until they fail.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 86. Tomorrow, we'll explore what your brain does. Until then, place your hand on your chest—and thank the organ that's never stopped working for you.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Essential Appreciation - Thank What Never Stops
growTrack.learning_objective: Appreciate systems that work reliably without attention
growTrack.activity: Your heart has beaten every moment of your life. Place your hand on your chest and feel it. Spend 30 seconds just appreciating this tireless worker. What other essential, reliable things in your life deserve this gratitude?
